stem.text: In $\beta^{-}$ decay, a neutron inside a nucleus changes to a proton.
Which statement describes the quark composition of the nucleus during the decay?

A.text: The number of down quarks decreases by one.

B.text: The number of down quarks increases by one.

C.text: The number of down quarks stays the same.

D.text: The number of up quarks stays the same.
